label: Employee directory (production)
description: What stands in for the employee directory under the production profile. bo and cy are laptop accounts and do not exist here: the one employee is the operator, in the registrar group, whose scrypt hash the environment supplies, so no credential that works in production is written in this repository. A tree with a real directory binds identity.port.json to an OIDC issuer or LDAP instead, which is another connection kind and so another binding, not a stand-in.
